# Chart key matrix

Every key, default, range and rule that chart validation accepts, as printed by `sidescope charts schema --format text`. The command is the source of truth; this file is its checked-in copy, and a test fails when they differ.

## `[[chart_sources]]`

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Range or choices | Pointer scope | Example | Meaning |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| id | string | yes |  |  |  | `"recent"` | Unique source id, [a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}; cards name it. |
| command | string-array | yes |  |  |  | `["example-chart-data", "--from", "{from}", "--to", "{to}", "--timezone", "{timezone}"]` | One argv, no shell. {from}, {to} and {timezone} must each be a whole argument. |
| format | enum | yes |  | sidescope-chart-v1 \| columns-v1 |  | `"columns-v1"` | Native payload, or producer JSON read through a mapping table. |
| window | string | no |  |  |  | `"3h"` | Whole-minute duration such as 90m, 3h or 2d, at most 30 days (43200 minutes). Exclusive with calendar_days. |
| calendar_days | integer | no |  | 1 to 400 |  | `5` | Calendar days including today in the source timezone. Exclusive with window. |
| timezone | string | yes |  |  |  | `"UTC"` | IANA zone; defines calendar days and axis labels. |
| refresh_seconds | integer | no | 30 | at least 5 |  | `30` | Seconds between scheduled runs; charts run executes once and ignores it. |
| timeout_seconds | integer | no | 10 | 1 to 60 |  | `10` | Seconds before the command's process group is stopped. |
| stale_after_seconds | integer | no | max(90, 2 * refresh_seconds) |  |  | `90` | Seconds after the last success before data counts as stale; at least twice refresh_seconds. |
| capture_stderr | boolean | no | false |  |  | `true` | Keep a sanitized 8 KiB stderr excerpt; the only way stderr text reaches a report. |
| mapping | table | no |  |  |  | `see the mapping section` | The [chart_sources.mapping] table; required for columns-v1, refused for sidescope-chart-v1. |

Rules:

- Set exactly one of window and calendar_days.
- mapping is required when format is columns-v1 and refused when it is sidescope-chart-v1.
- stale_after_seconds must be at least twice the effective refresh_seconds.
- command is one argv with a literal executable (no ~, $, glob, pipe, ; or \); braces appear only as the whole arguments {from}, {to} and {timezone}; no argument contains NUL.
- Source ids are unique.

## `[[chart_cards]]`

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Range or choices | Pointer scope | Example | Meaning |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| id | string | yes |  |  |  | `"recent-cost"` | Unique card id, [a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}. |
| source | string | yes |  |  |  | `"recent"` | The id of the chart source that feeds this card. |
| kind | enum | yes |  | time-series \| time-bars \| ranked-bars |  | `"time-series"` | Line over time, bars over time, or a ranking of groups. |
| metric | string | yes |  |  |  | `"metered_cost"` | A metric id of the source: declared by the mapping, or named in the native payload. |
| title | string | no |  |  |  | `"Recent cost"` | 1 to 128 plain characters; replaces the metric label as the card title. |
| summary | enum | no | sum for interval_total metrics, last for gauges | sum \| last |  | `"sum"` | How the card reduces the range to one figure. |
| group_by | string-array | no | [] |  |  | `["project"]` | Dimension names that split the metric into groups; no duplicates. |
| top_n | integer | no | 5 | 1 to 16 |  | `5` | Ranked-bars only: named rows kept before the rest fold into Other. |
| stack_by | string | no |  |  |  | `"model"` | Time-bars only: one dimension to stack; a non-empty group_by must equal it. |
| bounded_percent | boolean | no | false |  |  | `true` | Draw the axis 0 to 100; only for metrics whose unit is "percent". |

Rules:

- top_n is only for ranked-bars cards; stack_by is only for time-bars cards.
- summary sum needs an interval_total metric and last needs a gauge.
- bounded_percent needs a metric whose unit is exactly "percent".
- group_by names are unique.
- For columns-v1 sources the metric, summary, group_by and stack_by are checked against the mapping at load; for native sources they are checked against the first answer and a mismatch is a refused card.
- Card ids are unique and every card names an existing source.

## `[chart_sources.mapping]`

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Range or choices | Pointer scope | Example | Meaning |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| buckets | string | yes |  |  | absolute | `"/buckets"` | Array of interval objects. |
| interval_start | string | yes |  |  | bucket | `"/start"` | Interval start instant, relative to one bucket. |
| interval_end | string | yes |  |  | bucket | `"/end"` | Interval end instant, relative to one bucket. |
| groups | string | yes |  |  | absolute | `"/groups"` | Array of group objects. |
| dimensions | table-array | no | [] |  |  | `see the mapping_dimension section` | [[chart_sources.mapping.dimensions]] tables naming dimensions read from each group. |
| range_start | string | no |  |  | absolute | `"/range/start"` | Effective range start of the answer. |
| range_end | string | no |  |  | absolute | `"/range/end"` | Effective range end of the answer. |
| generated_at | string | no |  |  | absolute | `"/generatedAt"` | When the producer made the answer. |
| observed_through | string | no |  |  | absolute | `"/observedThrough"` | A collection watermark; absent means coverage stays unknown. |
| revision | string | no |  |  | absolute | `"/revision"` | A string or integer revision, reported as a diagnostic. |
| notices | string-array | no | [] |  | absolute | `["/notice"]` | Pointers to plain-text notices. |
| metrics | table-array | yes |  |  |  | `see the mapping_metric section` | [[chart_sources.mapping.metrics]] tables, one per metric; 1 to 32. |

Rules:

- Pointers are RFC 6901; a non-empty pointer starts with '/' and '~' is followed by 0 or 1.
- Pointer scope is absolute (whole answer), bucket (one element of buckets) or group (one element of groups).
- Dimension names and metric ids are unique; declare 1 to 32 metrics.
- Under omitted = "zero" a missing leaf is zero only when its immediate parent resolves to an object or array; an explicit null stays missing.

## `[[chart_sources.mapping.dimensions]]`

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Range or choices | Pointer scope | Example | Meaning |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| name | string | yes |  |  |  | `"project"` | Dimension name used by group_by and stack_by; 1 to 128 plain characters. |
| pointer | string | yes |  |  | group | `"/project"` | Where the dimension value sits in one group. |
| unknown_value | string | no |  |  |  | `"(unknown)"` | A producer placeholder meaning no value; shown as Unknown while the series keeps the raw text. |

## `[[chart_sources.mapping.metrics]]`

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Range or choices | Pointer scope | Example | Meaning |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| id | string | yes |  |  |  | `"metered_cost"` | Metric id a card names; unique within the mapping. |
| label | string | yes |  |  |  | `"Metered cost"` | Human label, 1 to 128 plain characters. |
| unit | string | yes |  |  |  | `"USD"` | Unit text; "percent" is the only unit bounded_percent accepts. |
| quantity | enum | yes |  | interval_total \| gauge |  | `"interval_total"` | interval_total reduces by sum, gauge by last. |
| estimate | boolean | no | false |  |  | `true` | The figure is an estimate, not a measurement. |
| unknown_contribution | enum | no |  | nonnegative \| unknown |  | `"nonnegative"` | What missing inputs may add; nonnegative makes a partial sum a lower bound. |
| values | string | yes |  |  | group | `"/columns/cost"` | Array aligned with the buckets, relative to one group. |
| omitted | enum | no | missing | missing \| zero |  | `"zero"` | zero: an absent values or counter column means all zeros; missing: it is missing. |
| quality_counter | string | no |  |  | group | `"/columns/incomplete_count"` | Aligned integers: 0 is complete, above 0 partial; relative to one group. |

Rules:

- quantity interval_total reduces by sum; quantity gauge reduces by last.
- With omitted = "zero", an absent values column or counter column counts as zero for every bucket; an explicit null is still missing.
- A quality counter above zero makes the cell partial; with unknown_contribution = "nonnegative" a partial sum is an at-least bound.

## Payload versions

| Version | Adds |
| :--- | :--- |
| sidescope-chart-v1 | nothing |
| sidescope-chart-v1.1 | sampled, breaks |

Quantity to reduction: interval_total is summed, gauge is read as last.

## Limits

| Name | Value | Meaning |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| max_intervals | 2048 | Intervals in one answer. |
| max_series | 256 | Series in one answer. |
| max_metrics | 32 | Metrics in one answer or mapping. |
| max_cells | 100000 | Cells (intervals x series x metrics) in one answer. |
| max_visible_series | 16 | Plotted groups per card, Other and every Unknown included. |
| stdout_bytes | 1048576 | A command's stdout; more is an output-bound failure and nothing is kept. |
| stderr_bytes | 8192 | Kept stderr when capture_stderr is set. |
| min_refresh_seconds | 5 | Smallest refresh_seconds. |
| default_refresh_seconds | 30 | refresh_seconds when unset. |
| default_timeout_seconds | 10 | timeout_seconds when unset. |
| stale_floor_seconds | 90 | Floor of the default stale_after_seconds. |
| max_window_minutes | 43200 | Longest fixed window. |
| max_concurrent_commands | 4 | Commands running at once. |
| report_bytes | 1048576 | A report larger than this becomes a report-too-large report. |
| details_default_limit | 500 | Details rows per page when --limit is not given. |
| details_max_limit | 5000 | Largest --limit. |

## Source error kinds

- invalid-config
- missing-executable
- spawn
- nonzero-exit
- timeout
- output-bound
- cancelled
- parse
- unsupported-version
- invalid-mapping
- invalid-dataset

## Report

Schema `sidescope-chart-report-v1`; statuses ok, findings, invalid, undetermined; exit codes 0 ok, 1 findings, 2 invalid, 3 undetermined.

Checks: config, request, execution, dataset, cards, freshness, coverage (never required), appearance (never required).
